title: Part 9
content_zh: Li Shen wrote the poem that every Chinese child knows: 'At noon they weed the fields under a scorching sun. Sweat drips into the soil beneath the grain. Who knows that every grain on your plate comes from bitter hardship?' For twelve centuries, this poem has been the conscience of Chinese civilization.
